subject: Geopolitics
title: Think Tanks and Academic Influence
description: A fast breakdown of Think Tanks and Academic Influence for builders.

hook.text: A respected think tank publishes a report favoring a foreign government's position.

buildup.text: States fund academic institutions, think tanks, and research centers abroad to shape expert opinion and policy debates.

discovery.text: China's Confucius Institutes operate on university campuses worldwide.

twist.text: Western governments do it too. US-funded organizations promote democracy and free markets in developing nations.

climax.text: Academic influence is subtle but powerful. Shaping what experts believe eventually shapes what governments decide.

punchline.text: Fund the research and you frame the debate.

quiz.question: How do states use think tanks for influence?
options: They replace all researchers with government agents
They fund research that supports their geopolitical positions
